title: Terrazzo Shower Curtain — Waterproof Polyester
seoTitle: Terrazzo Waterproof Shower Curtain, 12 Sizes | Drapewell
seoDescription: Thickened waterproof polyester shower curtain in a soft terrazzo print. 5 neutral colourways and 12 sizes from 39″ to 95″ wide. Shop Drapewell.
descriptionHtml:
A calm, Nordic-inspired refresh for your bathroom. Thickened polyester in a soft terrazzo print — neutral enough to disappear into a minimalist room, textured enough to stop it feeling bare.

  • 5 terrazzo colourways — mixed neutral tones suited to modern, Scandinavian, and minimalist bathrooms
  • 12 sizes — from 39.4″ × 70.9″ (100 × 180 cm) up to 94.5″ × 78.7″ (240 × 200 cm), fitting standard stalls through oversized walk-ins
  • Machine washable

Which size? A standard Canadian bathtub alcove takes 70.9″ × 70.9″ (180 × 180 cm). Measure your rod end to end and add 12″ so the curtain gathers properly instead of hanging flat.

Pairs with the Non-Slip Woven Bath Mat for a coordinated finish.

  • What's included — one shower curtain

Ships with tracking from our supplier. Estimated delivery is 13-25 days to Canada and 10-20 days to the US, counted from the order date. Taxes are extra and shipping is calculated by weight at checkout.
